# Stuntman

> The stunt double for every provider your app calls: SMS, WhatsApp, email, storage, queues, identity, secrets,
> webhooks, telemetry and any HTTP API. It answers like the provider, keeps state, sends callbacks and fails on
> cue. Every action is an MCP tool (streamable HTTP at /mcp) and an HTTP route under /api. Open source, Apache-2.0.

To set Stuntman up for a project, read and follow the agent setup guide step by step:

- [Agent setup guide](https://edivanteixeira.github.io/stuntman/agent-setup.md): start it, connect, find providers, configure, verify, welcome
